test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

I asked him where he had lost the pen I had brought for him the previous day.

options.text: I said to him, “Where do you lose the pen I had brought for him yesterday?”
I said to him, “Where he had lost the pen I brought for him yesterday?”
I said to him, “Where have you lost the pen I brought for you the previous day?”
I said to him, “Where have you lost the pen I brought for you yesterday?”

solution:
The correct answer is** I said to him, “Where have you lost the pen I brought for you yesterday?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rules for changing Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Past Perfect Tense.
 
• Past Perfect Tense changes to Present Perfect Tense.
 
• Insert the commas and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb asked is changed in said to as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the question mark in the sentence of Indirect speech.
 
• **The previous day** changes to **yesterday**.
 
• The question is changed to assertive form and is simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
 
• Example: *John said to Ravi, "Where have you met him?" *(Direct speech)
 
 
 
 

 * John asked Ravi where he had met him.* (Indirect speech)

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is I said to him, “Where have you lost the pen I brought for you yesterday?”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

__
 
• If the sentence of Direct speech has a question that cannot be answered by saying yes or no then it does not use “if” or “whether” in its Indirect speech.

 
 
• Example: * **She said to me, “Where did you buy this dress from?” *(Direct speech)

 * **She asked me where I had bought that dress from. *(Indirect speech)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• Indirect Speech को Direct Speech में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Past Perfect Tense में है।
 
• Past Perfect Tense, Present Perfect Tense में बदल जाता है।
 
• Commas और inverted commas जोड़ दे।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में that प्रयोग न करें।
 
• Asked रिपोर्टिंग verb वाक्य की प्रकृति के अनुसार said to में बदल जाती है।
 
• The previous day, yesterday में बदल जाता है।
 
• Question को assertive form में बदल दिया जाता है और केवल reporting verb के बाद रखा जाता है।
 
 
• Example: *John said to Ravi, "Where have you met him?" *(Direct speech)
 
 
 
 

 

 * John asked Ravi where he had met him.* (Indirect speech)
